1879-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1879-2105-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve Sidisi's Faithful. When it enters, its exploit ability triggers, exploiting the Zombie Rogue.

Repeat.

In this case, the first loop will not trigger Geralf. The Zombie Rogue token will have an additional counter placed on it each loop, meaning the final token will have infinite counters.

Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
